features.name: Healing Light
features.desc: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + your Warlock level. As a Bonus Action, you expend up to (Cha modifier) dice to heal a creature within 60 feet. You regain the pool when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.desc: Resistance to Radiant damage; once per turn, you add your Cha modifier to the damage of a Fire or Radiant spell.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.desc: At the end of a rest, you and your allies gain Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.desc: When you drop to 0 Hit Points (and aren't killed), you stay on your feet with a burst of radiant energy against enemies around you.
